mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production, defined as 3 consecutive monthly declines, signals a weakening supply-side economy that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve, defined as the 10-year Treasury yield falling below the federal funds rate, signals a looming recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where the yield curve inverts.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index, defined as a 3% y/y increase, signals an overheating economy that will prompt the Fed to tighten monetary policy, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL y/y growth exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment, defined as a 200k decline in PAYEMS over 1 month, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines > 200k in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in housing starts, defined as a 20% m/m decline in HOUST, signals a severe demand shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines > 20% m/m.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in real estate loan rates, defined as a 1pp increase in RSAFS over 3 months, signals a tightening of credit conditions that will pressure housing demand and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where RSAFS rises > 1pp in 3 months.
